name: save-boot-11d-battle-command-rows
description: #171 attempt 2, first menu. From "stats-battle" (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; a random battle in md1_1): wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait), 30 frames; the slot reads 2 (slot2, within 1 frame) and slot 2's row reads 0 (r2_zero, within 1 frame); mark, Down held 4 frames, 30 frames. A wait metric is the frames waited, 0 on a timeout (which stops the script). row0/row1/row2 and col* are read at the end of the script (the values of the command menu's cursor bytes, 0-255); r*_dir is the sign of the active slot's row at the end minus at the mark. Attempt 1 (#171) saw the slot read 2 and slot 2's row read 0, but Down every 20 frames did not make that row read 1 within 200 frames: this attempt reports where one Down press leaves the cursor instead of waiting for a value.
